title: Decision models (Clef / Nimble / Jev-style) via DeepInfra
description: Blocked on DeepInfra hosting a decision model. Typed choice / yes-no / score answers with probabilities, ~4 output tokens, to replace whole LLM turns for routing, moderation and best-of-N image picking. Fabio: build nothing until DeepInfra has one; a weekly check watches for it.
